notes.title: Emily is Away
notes.content:
[h3]Jump back in to the Emily series today with Emily is Away <3![/h3]
[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/978460/Emily_is_Away_3/][b]Available now on Steam![/b][/url]

Emily <3 is a brand new game on an entirely new platform! Sign into Facenook today for wall posts, poke wars, note surveys and more! Chat with your friends Emily, Evelyn and now Mat! Navigate your way through the branching narrative and see if your senior year ends in heartbreak or true love! In short: It's complicated.

[previewyoutube=4XCCbNgaWaA;full][/previewyoutube]

[h2]Longevity Update[/h2]
Along with the new game, Emily is Away Too is also getting a longevity update. This includes an engine upgrade and new builds for Mac OSX users! 

Thank you everyone for the continued support of my silly little games. It means the world to me!

notes.title: Emily Online - Steam Chat Skin!
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27851331/398ce6da36754b5f2fd6632037d07afd9ec085d2.gif[/img]
In honor of AIM shutting down their servers, Emily Too is getting a free content update! 

[h1]Emily Online is a retro themed Steam Chat skin![/h1]
[list]
    [*]Chat with your Steam Friends like it's 2007!
    [*]Send emoticons, change your text color, warn you friends.
    [*]Even create your custom buddy info!
[/list]

[b]To use Emily Online[/b] - Install Emily is Away Too, and select the Emily Online launch option.
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27851331/b37116dc8164b66e534c85fbf5b8f935859d0b1e.gif[/img]

PS - Thank you everyone who has played, talked about, and supported Emily is Away. I am seriously so grateful! I know this a small, non-story, update but I think it's a great way to make sure AIM is remembered. I hope you enjoy it!

notes.title: Emily is Away Too launches!
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27851331/7e8e8cc162d04c10318ac3d37b144680953c6f44.gif[/img]
[h1]Emily Too is out for PC, Mac and Linux![/h1]

If you find any bugs please report them in the [url=http://steamcommunity.com/app/523780/discussions/0/1291817208488358343/]Discussion Board[/url].

If you just want to surf 2006 youtoob and facenook, check out [url=http://emilyisaway.com/online/]Emily Online[/url].

Thanks everyone for the support! From people who let's played the first one, to others who just told their friends, the sequel wouldn't have happened without you. Thank you so much, I hope you enjoy Emily is Away Too!

notes.title: Emily Online and May 26th Release!
notes.content:
[h1]Emily Online[/h1]  [url=http://emilyisaway.com/online/]emilyisaway.com/online[/url] 
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27851331/f1b5475935f8193e2e4277a1c1813fae11cef0fd.gif[/img]
[i]Surf the web like it's 2006![/i]

 [url=http://emilyisaway.com/online/]Emily Online[/url] is the free, browser-based portion of Emily Too. Watch Youtoob videos, read Facenook profiles, and check out old YTMND memes.

[h1]Emily Release[/h1]
Emily is Away Too comes out on May 26th! It's 10x as large (word count wise) than Emily is Away, and contains links to hidden Emily Online pages, file transfers and multiple endings. It will be around $4.99. Wishlist it now to make sure you don't miss it!
